valid_guesses.decision: Use the original/pre-NYT Wordle 12,972-word valid-guess dictionary snapshot.
valid_guesses.source_basis: The repository documents this file as all 12,972 official valid 5-letter words taken from the original Wordle website source main.c1506a22.js.
valid_guesses.reproducibility: Pin the imported bytes to the exact upstream commit used during import; do not use a moving branch reference as the provenance record.

valid_answers.decision: Use the original/pre-NYT Wordle 2,315-answer pool corresponding to the same source snapshot.
valid_answers.source_basis: The repository documents this file as the official 2,315 common/answer words taken from the same original Wordle website source.
valid_answers.reproducibility: Pin the imported bytes to the exact upstream commit used during import; keep the answer source private in this application.

word_lists.relationship: VALID_ANSWERS must be a strict subset of VALID_GUESSES; pre-phase-6 verification must prove 2315/2315 membership.

emoji_policy.decision: Use standard Unicode RGI emoji corresponding to Discord's standard/default emoji, not Discord server/custom emoji.
selection_rule: Include only fully-qualified RGI emoji sequences from Unicode Emoji 17.0.
Exclude standalone emoji components that are not themselves RGI emoji.
Exclude Discord custom/server emoji and animated custom emoji.
Store the Unicode sequence itself in the database.
Do not copy Discord's proprietary artwork.
Do not manually curate down to the current 24-item list; replace that curated set.
Include standard gender/skin-tone RGI sequences only when they are themselves fully-qualified RGI emoji in the Unicode test data.
emoji_policy.important_note: Discord's API identifies standard emoji as Unicode characters and custom emoji separately. Discord documents Twemoji for Desktop/Android and native Apple emoji on iOS. Therefore the stable app-level identifier should be the Unicode sequence, not a Discord image.

repo_notes.current_avatar_state: 24 curated entries; this is the existing product decision to replace.
repo_notes.current_guess_source_state: Sample data; repository comments explicitly say it must be replaced with the real imported list.
repo_notes.answer_pool_rule: Keep answer data out of public client artifacts and follow the existing private seed pipeline.
